body: Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs (Fable2, 2026-10-05 about 06:26Z; supersedes eb17bcf3 for 92fc3d0, 690c5acf for bd2c5af and 2d0f7204 for 3abe2b2). Engram 08a04e0 (L-F1, w-63757ebca393: src/mcp.rs split) is installed: exe sha256 bcec822ae785fc97a16fcb66efae3f4205ded4f6cd6c60d33a29f008b7c23c13, build_fingerprint 081842231d48c5f4adac88d847e6098dc2b46ad5a66775171d07719327ca1eff (install notice: Engram::Fable, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #668). A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses this sha256 until the next install notice. 08a04e0 is an output-preserving refactor: MCP initialize and tools/list metadata are unchanged, and there is no schema change. Behaviour since bd2c5af comes from 92fc3d0: opening a brand-new store is atomic; a cold store refuses as a typed busy (SQLite BUSY), which TermAl maps like any SQLite error; next's changes list same-session changes made as another kind or by another actor. Running MCP sessions pick up 92fc3d0 at the next TermAl restart (not urgent).
